ad_set.name: Broad
ad_set.destination_comment: Target is Messenger + WhatsApp (MESSAGING_MESSENGER_WHATSAPP, like live 'Broad 1 - pic'), but the Meta MCP create tool rejects that value (2026-11-03 dry run). So: create with WHATSAPP, then the user flips Ad set > Message destination to 'Messenger and WhatsApp' in Ads Manager before publishing. Try MESSAGING_MESSENGER_WHATSAPP first on each launch in case the tool starts accepting it.
ad_set.requires_verified_advertiser_MY: Malaysia targeting needs a verified advertiser/payer. Set once per ad account: Ads Manager (desktop) > Advertising settings > Default advertiser and payer > Malaysia.

languages.comment: Meta locale IDs copied from the live 'Broad 1 - pic' ad set in G3 Setapak (proven to work).

creative.cta_comment: Use WHATSAPP_MESSAGE with a WHATSAPP ad set; MESSAGE_PAGE for MESSENGER. When the destination becomes Messenger+WhatsApp, Meta keeps a 'Send message' button.
creative.degrees_of_freedom_spec_comment: Multi-destination creatives need a DOF spec. Filled in from the first dry run; until then use what Meta's active_errors asks for.
